title: go-resty/resty v2
notes: resty.New() with its base URL set and nothing else; resty's own transport keeps GOMAXPROCS+1 idle connections per host, enough for eight lanes. SetResult(&out) has resty decode the JSON body (encoding/json) into an untyped value; the status is checked. The body is the fixture's prepared text, set with SetBody and Content-Type application/json.
